programme.desc: (2004) Shane Meadows' thriller starring Paddy Considine, Gary Stretch and Toby Kebbell. An ex-soldier is bent on revenge against the drug dealers who cruelly tormented his younger brother.

programme.title: The Sacrifice
programme.desc: (1986) Drama. Erland Josephson stars in director Andrei Tarkovsky's final movie. A birthday party is interrupted by a radio message announcing the outbreak of nuclear war. In Swedish/subs.

programme.title: The Man from Colorado
programme.desc: (1948) Western. When a sadistic Union colonel (Glenn Ford) becomes a federal judge after the Civil War, his friend (William Holden) takes the deputy job to try and temper his actions.

programme.title: Hombre
programme.desc: (1967) Paul Newman stars in this powerful western as a white man, brought up by Apaches, who reluctantly defends a stagecoach against a band of outlaws. With Richard Boone.

programme.title: The Nevadan
programme.desc: (1950) Western with Randolph Scott and Dorothy Malone. A cunning US Marshal pretends to be a doofus to get a bank robber to take him to the hidden loot.

programme.title: Anzio
programme.desc: (1968) Epic Second World War drama starring Robert Mitchum. A reporter gets trapped behind enemy lines during the costly 1944 Allied invasion of Italy. With Peter Falk and Robert Ryan.

programme.title: Taxi
programme.desc: (2004) All-action thriller. Queen Latifah stars as the driver of the fastest taxi in New York, who teams up with an inept cop (Jimmy Fallon) to catch a team of female bank-robbers.

programme.title: Plane
programme.desc: (2023) Action thriller starring Gerard Butler as an airline pilot who becomes a one-man army after crash landing on an island overrun by bad guys. To survive, he's gonna have to wing it.

programme.title: Bob Trevino Likes It
programme.desc: (2024) Tracie Laymon's bitter-sweet comedy drama stars Barbie Ferreira as a young woman who meets a man with the same name as her useless father and spots the opportunity for a reset...

programme.title: The Mission
programme.desc: (1986) Award-winning epic with Robert De Niro and Jeremy Irons. A Jesuit priest and a reformed slave trader forge an alliance to protect Indigenous South Americans from colonial Portugal.

programme.title: A Foreign Affair
programme.desc: (1948) Billy Wilder's film stars Jean Arthur and Marlene Dietrich as the chalk-and-cheese women in post-war Berlin with John Lund as the man caught between them.

programme.title: To Hell and Back
programme.desc: (1955) Fact-based wartime drama. Audie Murphy, America's most decorated soldier in WWII, plays himself in this dramatic recreation of the valiant heroics that earned him the honours.

programme.title: The Andromeda Strain
programme.desc: (1971) Sci-fi thriller. When a space rocket crash-lands in the US, a fatal alien virus is released, sparking a desperate battle to defeat the extraterrestrial life form and save mankind.

programme.title: Bridge of Spies
programme.desc: (2015) Tom Hanks and Mark Rylance star in Steven Spielberg's Cold War spy drama. After gaining notoriety for defending a Soviet spy, a US lawyer then tries to free a CIA pilot.

programme.title: Glory
programme.desc: (1989) Matthew Broderick, Denzel Washington and Morgan Freeman star in Edward Zwick's epic, Oscar-winning tribute to the first Black regiment raised in the North during the Civil War.

programme.title: Shame
programme.desc: (2011) Steve McQueen's adults-only drama about a good-looking, well-dressed and successful Manhattan tech exec who's addicted to sex. Starring Michael Fassbender and Carey Mulligan.

programme.title: Hilary and Jackie
programme.desc: (1999) Fact-based drama about the lives of the troubled genius, cellist Jacqueline du Pré (Emily Watson) and her sister Hilary (Rachel Griffiths). With David Morrissey. Strong language.

programme.title: Destroyer
programme.desc: (1943) There was an old boat - a post office that floats - that got dragged into the war. When it was torpedoed, in the seawater flowed. Can it deliver the mail any more? #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: They Rode West
programme.desc: (1954) A surgeon on the wild frontier, must save the Kiowa nation, by curing their malaria on a high-plains reservation. #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: Garden of Evil
programme.desc: (1954) In a derelict gold mining town, poor John Fuller is trapped underground. The Apache are near, so the danger is clear. For three drifters, the only way's down. #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: Anastasia
programme.desc: (1956) Ingrid Bergman's ingénue is chosen by Yul Brynner, to hoax the Russian royal court - but has he picked a winner? #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: Zathura: A Space Adventure
programme.desc: (2005) Two brothers play a game and get plunged deep into space. Can they get back home, past a hostile alien race? #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: The Holdovers
programme.desc: (2023) It's not cool to be stuck at school for Christmas. But can teacher and pupil get on after all, despite pedagogical fuss? With Paul Giamatti as one of the literati. #NationalPoetryDay

programme.title: The Integrity of Joseph Chambers
programme.desc: (2022) Joe's a bad survivalist - he really hasn't got the gist. He wants deer for his cooking pot, but it's Lone Wolf that ends up shot. #NationalPoetryDay
